misconceptions.adds-to-45: Thought the two angles are symmetric about 45° by adding, not by summing to 90°.
misconceptions.doubled-time: Doubled the time to the wall.
misconceptions.doubles: Doubled the angle instead of using 90° − θ.
misconceptions.fall-time-instead: Used the time to fall from the wall's height instead of the horizontal trip.
misconceptions.forgot-half: Dropped the ½ in h = ½gt².
misconceptions.forgot-the-2: Used only the time to the top: the trip down takes just as long.
misconceptions.heavier-falls-faster: Thought heavier or faster objects fall faster.
misconceptions.no-square-root: Forgot to take the square root when solving for t.
misconceptions.one-right-answer: Assumed only one angle can hit the target.
misconceptions.speed-changes-fall-time: Thought horizontal speed changes how long it takes to fall.

outcome: Horizontal and vertical motion are independent: the vertical motion sets the flight time, and distance = vₓ × time.
